To summarize, the key findings of our research, stated in one sentence that includes all relevant information, are that
a new glucose biosensor has been developed based on layer-by layer assembled multilayer films of chitosan (CH), gold nanoparticles (GNp) and glucose oxidase (GODO).
the layer-by-layer assembled multilayer films can be applied to fabricating biosensors, and the biosensors based on the six-layers of multilayer film showed a good performance.
a novel glucose biosensor was successfully constructed by layer-by-layer assembly method.
In summary, our research is concerned with
the construction and characterization of multilayer film based biosensor.
the development of a new method for the fabrication of biosensor.
a simple, sensitive and stable glucose biosensor.
In summary, a comprehensive and detailed conclusive statement would be that
the multilayer films based on CS, GNp and GOD are an excellent candidate as a biosensor platform.
the multilayer films based glucose biosensor has a good performance for glucose determination.
the multilayer films based biosensors have a great potential in clinical applications.
A comprehensive summary for our work would be that
the multilayer films of CS/GNp/GOD can efficiently enhance the performance of the glucose biosensor, and the method is a promising strategy for the fabrication of biosensors.
this work provides a new strategy to construct biosensors, which is simple and effective.
we have developed a new approach to immobilize GOD, which is based on the layer-by-layer assembled multilayer films of CS/GNp/GOD.
The main takeaway from our work is that
the layer-by-layer assembled multilayer films can be used for the fabrication of biosensors.
the multilayer film based glucose biosensor is a promising candidate for glucose detection in clinical applications.

the layer-by-layer assembled CS/GNp/GOD multilayer films can efficiently immobilize GOD and efficiently catalyze glucose oxidation, and thus the biosensor based thereon can efficiently detect glucose.
